decisions.text: E-007's remaining backlog text records the skills decision: one canonical skills/ directory in the package; Claude Code users receive skills through the plugin (Claude Code reads .claude/skills/, ~/.claude/skills/ and plugin skills, not .agents/skills/, per the docs 2026-10-15); Codex users through .agents/skills/ pointers written by init; nothing copied into a repo. decisions.source: chat 2026-10-15, addendum for plan §9, queued for implement:s3
decisions.text: CHARTER.md amendment, dated 2026-10-15: "Rules live in one AGENTS.md. init writes no CLAUDE.md except a one-line @AGENTS.md import when a CLAUDE.md, .claude/CLAUDE.md or CLAUDE.local.md in or above the repo would otherwise shadow it. Decided after verifying the Claude Code docs (AGENTS.md read natively since 2.1.277, all providers since 2.1.281)."

The runner's persisted --transcript-dir (an absolute local path in committed bundle state) is fixed in s1: the state keeps the run id only, the flag is dropped; after s1 lands the current runs are re-recorded without the path and the pre-fix state commits are rewritten before the branch is pushed (gate #0 on 06223a0 predates them and stays reachable). Logged as a backlog bug closed by this bundle.
The npm name cookwright is reserved by the developer now (a publish, their hands), before s1's docs land; the printed invocation stays npx cookwright.

doctor's git check when the config does not load: it judges the work tree only (PASS 'work tree; baseBranch unverified, config invalid' / FAIL not a work tree); the baseBranch half needs the config. Implemented in s2 with the §4.8 config-invalid cases.

The CHARTER amendment quoted in plan §2 says init writes CLAUDE.md only when a shadowing file exists; §4.4 step 4 also writes it when Claude Code is older than 2.1.281 (a version that ignores AGENTS.md). s3 surfaces the amendment wording to the developer in its strings batch before appending it; the developer's wording is final.

The leftover transcriptDir on plan-review run 0 was removed from state.json by hand (one key deleted, nothing else touched): the CLI refuses to re-record a done phase, so the re-record route of plan §2 (a) was not available. The pre-s1 state commits that still carry the path (97b5a76, 839bc5f, 4d4c78c) are rewritten before the branch is pushed, per the developer's decision.

probes.mjs (hasTool, claudeVersion, ignored, with tests) was not built in s1 because the recorded s1 scope predates the round-1 plan revision; s2 builds it as part of doctor (§4.8 probes, §4.4 step 6's ignored). levels.mjs holding only requires, with the level names and the no-next-level text in messages.levels / messages.noNextLevel, is accepted (it avoids a config → levels → messages → config cycle). The bundle CLI's other subcommands still ignoring unknown flags goes to the backlog in s3, beside E-004. The strings test of §4.9/§6 is s3's. The init/doctor placeholders are replaced by s3/s2.

Accepted as built: the loader's multi-line config message joined to one readout line; the 'cookwright doctor: ' prefix on the hook-mode counts line; weak and unverified appended to the level line with '; '; a check that throws is a FAIL row 'the check could not run'; --hook takes precedence over refusals (exit 0 always); rules.size measures every existing rules and shadowing file and is PASS with none. For s3: reuse hasImport (rules/block.mjs) and sessionStartCommands (doctor/claude.mjs) in init steps 4 and 5; write the block's prose in agents-block.md with RULES_VERSION staying 1; during the §7 dogfood add '!.env.example' to this repo's .gitignore so it matches what init writes, and set the README to say init and doctor exist. Backlog in s3: the hook command tests node_modules/cookwright under CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR, so a Claude session started in a subdirectory of the repo, or a package installed in a workspace sub-package, prints 'package not installed' although doctor would find the root from there.
